description: This file defines the ModuleListImpl class, a container for managing a list of neural network modules in PyTorch, including methods for adding, accessing, and manipulating modules, as well as cloning and printing.

classes.name: ModuleListImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a container class for managing a list of neural network modules, supporting iteration, access, insertion, extension, cloning, and printing.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ModuleList, optionally on a specified device.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Empty method, as ModuleList does not have parameters to reset.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Prints a representation of the ModuleList to an output stream.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds a module to the end of the list, accepting shared_ptr or value types.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Adds multiple modules from a container to the list.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the start of the list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the list.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses a module at a specific index, cast to a specified type.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns shared_ptr to the module at a specific index.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Returns shared_ptr to the module at a specific index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of modules in the list.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a module at a specified index.
